evals.prompt: List all documents in my Yuque knowledge base
evals.expected_output: The script runs `list` and returns a table of documents with IDs, titles, slugs, and update dates.

evals.prompt: Create a new Yuque document titled 'Test Doc' with body '# Hello World'
evals.expected_output: The script runs `create` with --title and --body, returns the created doc ID, and appends it to the TOC.
assertions: The created doc appears in subsequent list output

evals.prompt: Update the Yuque document with slug 'test-doc' to have a new title 'Updated Title'
evals.expected_output: The script runs `update` with the slug and --title flag, returns confirmation of the update.
assertions: A subsequent get shows the new title

evals.prompt: Delete the Yuque document with ID 12345
evals.expected_output: The script fetches doc details first, prints what is being deleted to stderr, then runs `delete` with --confirm flag and returns confirmation of deletion.
assertions: The --confirm flag is included in the command
Stderr contains the doc title before deletion
The doc no longer appears in list output

evals.prompt: Create a document from local file ./notes.md without adding it to the table of contents
evals.expected_output: The script runs `create` with --body-file and --no-toc flags.
assertions: The --body-file flag is used instead of --body
Output contains 'Created doc' but NOT 'Added to TOC'

evals.prompt: Try to list documents without a .env file configured
evals.expected_output: The script fails with a clear error about missing YUQUE_TOKEN.

evals.prompt: Set up the Yuque skill for the first time with URL 'https://www.yuque.com/mygroup/mybook' and a valid token
evals.expected_output: The script runs `setup`, parses the URL, verifies the connection, writes .env, and checks .gitignore.
assertions: The setup command is used with --url and --token flags
Output or stderr indicates connection verified
Output or stderr indicates .env was written

evals.prompt: Try to set up with an invalid API token
evals.expected_output: The script runs `setup` but fails at the connection verification step with a clear auth error.
assertions: Stderr contains an authentication error message

evals.prompt: Run setup again when a .env file already exists, without --force
evals.expected_output: The script detects the existing .env and stops with an error suggesting --force.
